author: tiemefgroup
name: neuro-noise-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Neuro Noise style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#140A00, #FF6D00, #FFC300, #FFF1B8). Features: high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
